title: Extension Wrench 2-in-1 – Ratchet Wrench with Sockets
descriptionHtml:
One wrench that replaces several

Hunting for the right socket and wrench in the middle of a job takes time and patience. Tight spaces make it even harder.

Two functions in one tool

This extension wrench works as both a ratchet wrench and an extension. You reach more bolts with a single tool and don't have to keep switching.

Features

  • 2-in-1 – ratchet wrench and extension
  • Reaches tight spaces
  • Universal fit for common sockets
  • Complete set for both home and the garage
  • Durable material that lasts

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
